Name: MythicPhoenix's Skogkatt (Norwegian Forest Cat)
Author: MythicFenix
Description:
EDIT 10/12/19: Made some small adjustments to the sprites.
EDIT 4/6/19: Added .xnb files to the assests folders.  Copy the desired cat.xnb and paste into content/animals to use this way.

Changes the pet cat to a Skogkatt/Norwegian Forest Cat.  Choose between the two by editing the config file.  The Norwegian Forest Cat is a very old breed.  They are VERY large and VERY fluffy.  The vikings called them Skogkatt(s?) and thought them to be a fairy creature.  The goddess Freya's chariot was pulled by two skogkatt.  I modeled this cat off of my Norwegian Forest Cat mix.

I am still brand new to modding, so if you see any errors please let me know!  I wasn't able to do quite what I wanted to with the fairy light effect, but if I can figure out a better way to do it I will release an update.  Thank you and I hope you enjoy it!

[code][size=5]Install[/size][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list][/code]
